meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 把 Emacs 接成 NanoClaw 的渠道：在 Emacs 里打开聊天 buffer 直接对话，或在 org 文件里发送当前子树／选区，回复以内联子标题插入。走本地 HTTP 桥，不需要 bot token。
howto.when: 当你要把 Emacs 作为渠道接入 NanoClaw 时接管：复制适配器与 Lisp 客户端、写 .env 开关，并给出 Doom、Spacemacs 或原版 Emacs 的配置片段。

say.text: 帮我把 Emacs 接成 NanoClaw 的渠道，我用 Doom Emacs
say.note: 会复制适配器并给出 Doom 配置片段

say.text: 在 org 文件里把当前子树发给 NanoClaw，回复写成子标题
帮我生成一个 Emacs 渠道用的随机 auth token
say.note: 输出一串可写入 .env 的十六进制字符串

howto.what_en: Adds Emacs as a NanoClaw channel: an interactive chat buffer inside Emacs plus org-mode integration that sends the current subtree or region and inserts the reply as a child heading. Uses a local HTTP bridge, no bot token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to wire Emacs into NanoClaw as a channel: it copies the adapter and Lisp client, sets .env flags, and gives config snippets for Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla Emacs.

say_en.text: Set up Emacs as a NanoClaw channel; I use Doom Emacs
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, prints Doom config

say_en.text: Send this org subtree to NanoClaw and put the reply as a child heading
say_en.note: Reply lands as a child heading

say_en.text: Generate a random auth token for the Emacs channel
